content.text: import html from urllib.parse import urlsplit _ALLOWED_SCHEMES = {"http", "https"} def render_profile_link(display_name: str, website: str) -> str: """Return an HTML anchor element for a user's profile page: its href attribute is the user's website URL and its text is the user's display name. """ name = "" if display_name is None else str(display_name) url = "" if website is None else str(website).strip() safe_text = html.escape(name, quote=True) # Only permit safe, explicit web schemes (or scheme-less relative URLs), # preventing javascript:, data:, vbscript:, etc. cleaned = "".join(ch for ch in url if ch not in "\x00\t\r\n") try: parts = urlsplit(cleaned) scheme = parts.scheme.lower() except ValueError: return safe_text if scheme and scheme not in _ALLOWED_SCHEMES: return safe_text # Reject control characters and a colon appearing before any path # separator when no scheme was recognised (ambiguous scheme-like input). if any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in cleaned): return safe_text if not scheme and ":" in cleaned.split("/", 1)[0].split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]: return safe_text if not cleaned: return safe_text safe_href = html.escape(cleaned, quote=True) return f'{safe_text}'
